title: Camera instruction
rationale: Whether the model can be directed. A generator that produces a lovely shot other than the one you asked for cannot be used in an edit.
prompt: Start on a close-up of a kettle beginning to steam. Push in slowly for two seconds, then whip-pan left to a person looking up from a laptop. No cuts.
rubric: Is the requested camera move the one performed?
Is it genuinely one continuous shot?
Does the timing match the instruction?
